title: Time-asymptotic stability of generic Riemann solutions for viscous-dispersive heat-conducting compressible fluids
summary: We establish the time-asymptotic stability of generic Riemann solutions for the one-dimensional Navier-Stokes-Fourier-Korteweg (NSFK) system, which describes the dynamics of viscous, heat-conducting, compressible fluids with internal capillarity.
